Scope of Service The Contractor shall provide one vehicle (Maruti Suzuki Ertiga/ Mahindra XUV 500/ Maruti Suzuki XL6/ ) along with a qu alified driver for official use. 2. Working Hours The vehicle shall be available for duty on a 24 × 7 basis. The Contractor shall deploy an adequate number of qualified drivers to ensure uninterrupted operation of the vehicle during the prescribed duty hours, while ensuring that the worki ng hours, rest intervals, weekly off, overtime, and other service conditions of each driver are in full compliance with the applicable Labour Laws and other statutory provisions in force. Additional payment at accepted hourly rates shall be made for numbers of hours beyond 360 /372 hrs. in month of 30 /

31 days. 3. Driver Requirements The Contractor shall deploy licensed, experienced and medically fit driver possessing a valid driving licence and all stat utory documents. The driver shall: a) Be punctual and report on duty as instructed. b) Be courteous, obedient, disciplined and maintain a polite behaviour with officers, staff and visitors. c) Be dressed in white chauffeur uniform provided by the service provider in neat and clean condition while on duty. d) Maintain personal hygiene and professional conduct at all times. e) Not consume or remain under the influence of alcohol, intoxicants, narcotic substances, tobacco, gutkha, pan masal a, smoking products or any other prohibited substance during duty hours. f) Not use mobile phone while driving except through legally permitted hands-free arrangements in emergency situatio ns. g) Maintain confidentiality of official discussions and movements. h) Follow all traffic rules and safety regulations. 4. Compliance with Labour Laws The Contractor shall comply with all provisions of the Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Wages Act, EPF, ESI, Bonus, Lea ve and other applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Any liability arising due to non-compliance of labour laws shall be solely borne by the Contractor. 5. Registration on Shramik Kalyan Portal and Labour Law Compliance a) The Contractor shall mandatorily be registered on the Railway Shramik Kalyan Portal (RSKP) / Shramik Kalyan Portal and shall maintain such registration valid throughout the currency of the contract. b) Before commencement of work, the Contractor shall submit documentary evidence of registration on the Shramik K alyan Portal to the Employer. c) The Contractor shall ensure registration of all drivers and other manpower deployed under this contract on the Shra mik Kalyan Portal as per prevailing Railway Board instructions and Labour Laws. d) Monthly wage payment details, statutory compliance records, EPF, ESI and other labour-related information shall be uploaded and maintained on the Shramik Kalyan Portal as required by applicable Railway Board guidelines. e) The Contractor shall ensure payment of wages not less than the prescribed Minimum Wages and compliance with all prevailing Labour Laws, including provisions relating to EPF, ESI, Bonus, Leave, Working Hours and Occupational Safety . f) Failure to obtain or maintain valid registration on the Shramik Kalyan Portal, or failure to update mandatory records on the Portal, shall be treated as a breach of contract and may attract withholding of bills, imposition of penalties and/o r termination of contract as decided by the Employer. g) The Contractor shall indemnify the Railway Administration against any claims, liabilities, penalties or legal conseque nces arising out of non-compliance with labour laws or Shramik Kalyan Portal requirements. 6. Vehicle Condition The vehicle shall be maintained in excellent roadworthy condition with functioning AC, clean interiors, clean seat cover s, proper floor mats and all accessories in working order. 7. Replacement of Vehicle/Driver In case of breakdown, accident, prolonged maintenance or unsatisfactory performance of the driver, immediate replace ment vehicle/driver shall be provided without any extra cost. 8. Inspection, Deficiency and Penalty Clause

The vehicle and services provided under this contract shall be subject to daily inspection as per the prescribed e Inspection Checklist at Annexure - B. a) The Checklist is attached and the Contractor shall ensure that all checklist items are complied with at all times. b) In case any deficiency, defect, non-compliance or unsatisfactory condition is observed against any item of the check list during inspection, a penalty of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) shall be imposed for each deficiency per occas ion. c) The penalty shall be recovered from the Contractor's monthly bill(s). d) Repeated deficiencies shall be treated as separate instances and shall attract separate penalties. e) If the cumulative penalty imposed during the currency of the contract exceeds Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Th ousand only), the Employer shall have the right to terminate the contract forthwith without any further notice and mak e alternative arrangements at the risk and cost of the Contractor. f) The decision of the Employer regarding assessment of deficiencies and imposition of penalties shall be final and bind ing on the Contractor. 9.
